name: cavemio-voice-input
title: Voice input
description: Dictate a prompt: a waveform from your real mic level, a timer, then transcribing.

cavemio.usage:
import { VoiceInput } from "@/components/voice-input";

<VoiceInput status={status} level={level} startedAt={startedAt} onStart={start} onStop={stop} onCancel={cancel} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- Buttons are labelled "Dictate", "Stop and transcribe" and "Cancel"; listening and transcribing are announced as status.
- The waveform is decorative (aria-hidden); the timer and transcript carry the information.
- Blocked and error use role="alert". Give the component the width the bar should fill; the mic stretches across it from its own side: align="start" (default) grows rightwards, align="end" puts the mic beside Send and grows leftwards, mirroring the bar and the error line.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the bar changes size in place and the fallback wave holds still.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: level
props.description: – · Current mic level, 0 to 1. Each change adds a bar; without it the bars move in a gentle wave.

props.name: transcript
props.description: – · Words recognised so far, e.g. from the Web Speech API.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: – · When listening started (ms); shows the timer.

props.name: onStart / onStop / onCancel
props.description: – · Mic button and Try again; Stop and transcribe; Cancel.

props.name: errorText
props.description: – · Overrides the blocked or error explanation.

props.name: align
props.description: "start" · Which side the mic sits on; the bar grows from there. Use "end" for a mic beside Send.

features.title: One surface from start to finish
features.description: The mic button stretches into the listening bar as the mic blurs into Stop, and shrinks back afterwards.

features.title: A waveform from the real mic level
features.description: Pass the level and the bars react to the voice instead of looping.

features.title: Words as they are recognised
features.description: The transcript so far opens above the bar, and the timer’s seconds roll.

features.title: A transcribing state
features.description: Stop becomes a spinner, the waveform settles flat and “Transcribing” rises over it.

features.title: Blocked microphones are explained
features.description: The icon crosses out, where to allow it opens beside it, and Try again is offered.

features.title: Fits beside Send
features.description: Set align="end" and the bar grows leftwards from a mic that sits next to the Send button.

states.title: listening
states.description: The button stretches into a 44px bar over 520ms while the mic blurs into Stop; the waveform, a timer whose seconds roll and Cancel fade in once there’s room. The transcript so far opens above.

states.title: transcribing
states.description: Stop blurs into a spinner, the waveform settles flat and fades as "Transcribing" rises under a sweep of light; afterwards the bar shrinks back into the mic.

states.title: blocked
states.description: Microphone permission was denied: the mic blurs into a crossed-out one and where to allow it opens beside it, with Try again.

states.title: error
states.description: Nothing usable was heard; the title morphs to "Didn’t catch that", with Try again.
